title: Evidence Citation
description: The atomic unit every finding and every artifacts_read/artifacts_consumed entry is built from. Added 2026-09-19 as part of the common finding/evidence/interjob-transfer format effort (see claude project TODO).

source_type.description: tool_output = a deterministic scanner's own output file; source_file = target repo source/config; upstream_lane = another lane's status.json/result.md; manual_diagnostic = a one-off command run and recorded (e.g. a docker run sanity check); reference_data = a curated offline reference file (eol-reference.json, cis-*-reference.json, etc.).

path.description: Relative to engagement_output for tool_output/reference_data, relative to the target repo root for source_file, or the real outputs/<lane>/{status.json,result.md} path for upstream_lane.

tool_rule_id.description: e.g. a ShellCheck SC code, a PSScriptAnalyzer rule name, a CodeQL query id, a Semgrep rule id.

content_hash.description: sha256 of the cited file at citation time, when feasible. Lets a downstream validator detect that evidence changed since a claim cited it -- this project has hit real stale-evidence bugs (item #16, #20, #22 in the harness doc) that a hash check would have caught immediately instead of requiring a manual mtime/git-log investigation.
